glossary.meaning: Reference label for each shipment.
Business sending the goods.
Where the goods are collected from.
Where the goods are delivered.
Kind of site receiving the goods: Warehouse or Business address.
Day the goods will be packed and ready for collection (DD-MM-YYYY).
What matters most to the seller. Most reliable = highest on-time rate; Balanced = no strong preference, best trade-off of cost, speed and reliability.
Number of pallets, as the seller states it. A pallet is a platform holding many cartons.
Total cartons, as the seller states it. A carton is a box of units.
Total value of the goods, as the seller states it.
Currency of every money value. GBP only.
Weight of everything shipped, including cartons and pallets, as the seller states it.
Whether the seller has a delivery time slot booked at the receiving site.
Seller's product code and a plain description.
Customs code that classifies the product, as the seller states it. May be blank.
Total units of this product, as the seller states it.
Price of one unit, in GBP.
Units packed in one carton.
Weight of one unit.
Where the product was made, not where it ships from. May be blank.
Carrier name and its service level.
Cost to ship one pallet, in GBP.
Days from collection to delivery.
Share of shipments that arrive on the promised day.
Heaviest pallet the service accepts.
